title: Google Indexing & SEO Visibility Issues
description: Fix pages not appearing in Google, accidental noindex, sitemap errors, and Search Console coverage problems.

steps.title: Identify Indexing Problem Scope
steps.instructions: Check if whole site, specific pages, or new content is affected. Review Google Search Console Coverage report for errors and excluded pages.

steps.title: Audit noindex and Discourage Search Engines
steps.instructions: Uncheck 'Discourage search engines' under Settings → Reading on production. Check SEO plugin noindex settings per post, CPT, and archive.

steps.title: Review robots.txt
steps.instructions: Ensure robots.txt does not block important paths. WordPress virtual robots.txt should allow crawling. SEO plugins may add disallow rules — audit carefully.

steps.title: Fix XML Sitemap
steps.instructions: Verify sitemap at /wp-sitemap.xml or SEO plugin sitemap URL. Submit in Search Console. Fix 404s, redirect chains, and excluded post types in sitemap settings.

steps.title: Check Canonical URLs and Redirects
steps.instructions: Duplicate content, wrong canonical tags, or redirect loops prevent indexing. Audit with SEO plugin and Screaming Frog or similar crawler.

steps.title: Ensure Staging Is Not Indexed
steps.instructions: If staging was indexed, noindex it and password-protect. Request removal in Search Console. Verify production URLs are canonical.

steps.title: Request Indexing for Key Pages
steps.instructions: Use Search Console URL Inspection to request indexing for homepage and priority pages after fixes. Allow 1–2 weeks for recrawl.

steps.title: Monitor Search Console for 30 Days
steps.instructions: Watch Coverage and Performance reports. Confirm indexed page count increases and critical errors resolve.
